Game 2: BB in Wasteland. Haka last hero standing. HoR only Haka played. Haka drew 11 cards outside of draw phase via Dominion, Mere, & HoR(x2). Library not played. No unlock.

Game 3: BB in Wasteland. Haka last hero standing. HoR, HoS, and HoB all played. Haka drew 9 cards outside of draw phase via Dominion, Mere and one of each Haka. Library not played. Unlocked.
